messages:
Sara: Quick heads-up — planning the users.email -> users_v2.email column migration next Tue 03:00 UTC. Goal: minimal downtime, dual-write + backfill. Who can own the deploy and smoke checks? 
Tony: I can own the deploy. will do the canary + smoke. tagging @Maya for backfill readiness. :+1:
Maya: I’ll run the backfill job and monitor. ETA for backfill is ~45m with current replica lag. will post progress in this thread.
Nikhil: FYI we should limit dual-write window to 10–15m and enable prefix cache warmup before cutover. Also set a short throttling rule for writes.
Sara: Thanks — dual-write 15m sounds safe. Tony, plan: 1) preflight checks 30m before 2) enable dual-write flag 3) run small canary (100 users) 4) full backfill 5) switch read routing.
Tony: Got it. Preflight checklist (quick):
```
- confirm replicas < 5s lag
- migrations reviewed + tested in staging
- rollout config in deploy service set to canary 5%
- alerting page-up on pg write errors
```
Maya: Backfill command I'll run:
```bash
./backfill_users_v2 --batch-size=2000 --resume-token=$TOKEN --verify-checksums
```
Expect logs to show progress every 5m.
DeployBot: Deployment window reservation approved for 2024-09-10 03:00 UTC by infra-scheduler.
Tony: Canary run plan: create 100 test users via checkout script, validate email fields in v2 and fallback. Smoke tests: auth, login, profile read, email send. If any failure >=1% for canary, rollback.
Sara: Rollback readiness: feature flag to disable dual-write (instant), backfill pause + resume, snapshot of primary before switch, and a rollback runbook link: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/users-migration-rollback
Nikhil: Oncall DB: @oncall-db will be on standby 03:00–05:00 UTC. If replication lag > 20s or error spikes, we abort and rollback.
oncall-db: Acknowledged — will watch metrics and be ready to run PITR if needed.
Maya: I'll post progress pings every 15m in this thread and the #eng-sre channel.
Tony: I'll kick off preflight 30m prior and post green here. Thanks all. :rocket:
